notes.title: Version 1.06 Update
notes.content:
[b]Dictionary searching should work a little better now[/b]
    - Fixed a problem with searching for romaji while in No Romaji mode, which could lead to some strange matches
    - Sorting now prioritizes exact matches over partial matches

[b]Fixed some errors[/b]
    - Level 9-7: Fixed the ダンスのクラス narration audio clip
    - Level 10-3: Fixed the outgoing arrow, which was always unlocked
    - Level 15-5: Fixed the 何をしているの translation

[b]Tried to make some frustrating solutions more obvious[/b]
    - Level 5-6: 安い (yasui)
    - Level 5-14: で (de)
    - Level 7-1: まっすぐ (massugu)
    - Level 7-3: となり (tonari)
    - Level 7-4: しないで (shinaide)
    - Level 9-13: か (ka)
    - Level 11-5: いい (ii) [a conjugation of 言う]

[b]Minor[/b]
    - Increased volume slider responsiveness when the dictionary is large
    - Some other small things

notes.title: Version 1.05 Update
notes.content:
- Fixed a potential crash on Level 3-7 with チケットうりば when ば was matched to 場.
- Made the books a little more obvious in Level 12-2.
- Fixed a translation error with "Curry Rice" in Level 13-13.

notes.title: Version 1.04 Update
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug with uppercase/lowercase conversions that made the game unplayable on some computers where the region was set to Turkey (Türkiye).
- Made the calendar highlighting in Level 9-21 a little more obvious.

notes.title: Version 1.03 Update
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug introduced in Version 1.01 that set all the volume sliders to 0 and set the game to windowed mode when loading the game for the first time.
- Fixed an English translation error in Level 14-4 with the giraffe.

notes.title: Version 1.02 Update
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug with certain verb conjugations. This should resolve the Level 12-5 いきましょう (ikimashou) softlock problem, and potentially others.
- Fixed an English translation mistake in Level 7-1 involving the trees.
- Fixed the convenience store art in Level 12-5.

notes.title: Version 1.01 Update
notes.content: - Fixed a bug preventing the game from saving correctly in countries that use commas instead of periods for decimal points
